purpose: Glass shelf-jump chips: frost plates that carry a section word and an optional glyph, sized by the pack's chip token.

anatomy.note: Frost plate, 999dp radius, glyph + label, active = brighter plate.

rules: LEFT/RIGHT step chips; DOWN enters the first rail.
A chip jumps to the rail it names; it never filters silently.

behaviour: A chip exists only when its shelf exists — Games/Live follow the add-on gate.

platformDeltas.ios: A horizontally scrolling capsule row with the same copy.
platformDeltas.windows: Same chips; pointer hover adds a border, not a scale.
